name: Roger Lau
subject: We noticed you:
body:
---
Derek — it’s Roger Lau. I’m reaching out today because our team at the DNC noticed that you’re one of our most engaged grassroots supporters. I know you've been getting our emails for a while, staying up to date on our work, maybe you've been sharing our social media posts, or even volunteering some of your time to elect Democrats in Pennsylvania._I can’t thank you enough for it._ Every little bit has helped us continue building momentum ahead of one of the most pivotal midterms of our lives. Today, I’m reaching out to [**ask you to take the next step and chip in $7 to the DNC.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260711_8007_fr&refcode2=8007_22930333_mj14e6&akid=8007%2E22930333%2Emj14e6)** But, first, I want to take a second to explain why your support is so important to the DNC’s mission: **Democrats have a huge opportunity to flip Congress and put a real check on Donald Trump’s power in November.** We’ve been working around the clock to make sure we reach as many voters as we can across the country, and we’re not stopping there. As I write this email, we have organizers on the ground registering tens of thousands of young voters. We have a brilliant team of social media strategists exposing Trump’s lies and cruelty to the world. And we have lawyers taking the Trump administration to court. The work our team is doing right now isn’t just going to help Democrats win big _this_ year — it’s building the infrastructure necessary to keep winning for _years to come_. **But here’s the thing, Derek: None of this is possible without the support of grassroots supporters like you.** [**So here’s the part where I ask: Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today to help us scale up our efforts to elect Democrats up and down the ballot? talked a lot about this upcoming election on November 3rd — and for good
reason.

All across the country, we’ve seen what happens when election deniers are
in charge: Lies and conspiracy theories run rampant. Even blueprints to
throw out eligible ballots and completely overturn the results of an
election are spread among far-right politicians and their allies.

election — and Derek,

They only failed because Pennsylvania elected Democrats to statewide
office — not election deniers.

states in the entire country. And it’s going to stay that way. So when the
far-right tries to pull their tricks in the next election — and every

MAGA wants to wipe out Black representation in Louisiana without getting any more blood on their hands.
| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OMLLXAT6GkDSascx3h3MEeoLHpxnAXMUGqWcEmDduTY5nthsiy-8eSrX2NfifKzv89BTYtbByzX6Atl2BWUNKnprC3oY8JRXI5uDd41dlAHYyj1cZqQSA6gEQgTy6HIT8Tv4pm3pynWvfQcJ22NhwSf01B-B681B0-Bbez3W5mIAknhXvuZFas4jmaxuY08w5zSQnDRRU9pxc3zzbDcDQgSyzNheBV9P8gshNpkTQBsm79N5Wcz1Nw==&c=-Mtvl2MnYjaLimDlmK2YLPz7VvWPkfyKowsovoXNnYK-SV4Sw48hsQ==&ch=MS3XspiWXeWUk_LBjUkG4XyTsHUiWglefT3eYNZF6Eov69SAXLNuYQ==)

| Peter,
My name is Troy Carter and I proudly represent Louisiana's 2nd congressional district, the last remaining majority-Black district in the state.
And if MAGA has its way, the district I represent will be the last ever majority-Black district in Louisiana. I could very well be Louisiana's last Black Congressman.
By now, you've heard about what MAGA did to Black voters in Louisiana.
In April, the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Then MAGA declared a state of emergency to cancel our election, tossed out tens of thousands of ballots, and rammed through a brand-new map that erased one of our majority-Black districts -- the seat held by my colleague and dear friend Cleo Fields.
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OMLLXAT6GkDSascx3h3MEeoLHpxnAXMUGqWcEmDduTY5nthsiy-8eSrX2NfifKzv89BTYtbByzX6Atl2BWUNKnprC3oY8JRXI5uDd41dlAHYyj1cZqQSA6gEQgTy6HIT8Tv4pm3pynWvfQcJ22NhwSf01B-B681B0-Bbez3W5mIAknhXvuZFas4jmaxuY08w5zSQnDRRU9pxc3zzbDcDQgSyzNheBV9POr4NcENiCxp0ZM53E-kGJg==&c=-Mtvl2MnYjaLimDlmK2YLPz7VvWPkfyKowsovoXNnYK-SV4Sw48hsQ==&ch=MS3XspiWXeWUk_LBjUkG4XyTsHUiWglefT3eYNZF6Eov69SAXLNuYQ==)
---
But that's not the full story.
While they were debating the map that wiped out Cleo's district, MAGA had a second map waiting in the wings -- one that went even further. It eliminated my district too. Then Black voters showed up. They flooded the Capitol, furious at being stripped of their representation. And facing that kind of heat, MAGA blinked.
And then MAGA pulled a bait and switch. They benched the map that killed my district and passed the one that eliminated Cleo's -- and the moment the ink was dry, they sprang the trap:
---
| [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OMLLXAT6GkDSascx3h3MEeoLHpxnAXMUGqWcEmDduTY5nthsiy-8eSrX2NfifKzv89BTYtbByzX6Atl2BWUNKnprC3oY8JRXI5uDd41dlAHYyj1cZqQSA6gEQgTy6HIT8Tv4pm3pynWvfQcJ22NhwSf01B-B681B0-Bbez3W5mIAknhXvuZFas4jmaxuY08w5zSQnDRRU9pxc3zzbDcDQgSyzNheBV9PAfSIcMUgNXe2HDVD0_ywRQ==&c=-Mtvl2MnYjaLimDlmK2YLPz7VvWPkfyKowsovoXNnYK-SV4Sw48hsQ==&ch=MS3XspiWXeWUk_LBjUkG4XyTsHUiWglefT3eYNZF6Eov69SAXLNuYQ==)
---
MAGA activists immediately challenged the very map their own legislature had just passed, claiming my district was an "illegal racial gerrymander." It was a setup. They didn't want to vote to eliminate my seat in the open, so they're trying to get a court to do their dirty work behind closed doors -- so MAGA can wipe out Black representation in Louisiana without any more blood on their hands.
We've been here before. I'm one of five Black people elected to serve in Congress, the fourth since Reconstruction. The first, John Willis Menard, was denied his seat in Congress, challenged by that period's MAGA movement.
I'm not backing down from this fight. But I can't win it alone. Right now, MAGA's lawyers are working to convince a court to do what they were too scared to do in the open: erase my district and silence the Black voters who sent me to Congress. They are betting that we'll be too tired, too distracted, or too broken to fight back. Let's prove them wrong.
[That's where you come in, Peter. We need a surge in support of Democrats from across the nation to help us fight for Louisiana's last majority-Black district. Can I count on you to chip in $50, $25, or even $15 to stand with every Black voter in Louisiana who refuses to let MAGA drag this state back to the Jim Crow era? ](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OMLLXAT6GkDSascx3h3MEeoLHpxnAXMUGqWcEmDduTY5nthsiy-8eSrX2NfifKzv_Kp6deqkpgN1ekg3We0qQLLt-ZjaSyBono1MNCTg7swafpQua9cate5y-1YniNXqGziUdU12GyFviRe7fksBj5EaANEzZ_MW5crW6KbY3I8Bmd26t2TfDzcS_lIQEmDezhXBEo3AyDdZog88i0bskiohGrGTKo937njYDYBz22W9ILMaiLK0J4efQJKjJUU2&c=-Mtvl2MnYjaLimDlmK2YLPz7VvWPkfyKowsovoXNnYK-SV4Sw48hsQ==&ch=MS3XspiWXeWUk_LBjUkG4XyTsHUiWglefT3eYNZF6Eov69SAXLNuYQ==)

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

AIPAC is on pace to spend more than ever before on our elections this
cycle.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260711-2.0GMw-2&refcode=em20260711-38016&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=38016%2E1203867%2EMesUOI ]Headline from POLITICO: "As AIPAC spending surges, it faces a big
primary test: AIPAC is on pace to surpass its previous spending records.
It's become an issue in Maryland and New York."

As of June 23rd, the pro-Israel lobby group — along with its super PACs,
shell PACs, and donations to other groups — has spent more than $38
million on 2026 races.

That’s more than the $22 million they spent in 2022, and it’s on track to
surpass the historic $46 million they spent in 2024 when they unseated
Justice Democrats Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman.

But since public opinion is turning against Israel and AIPAC in light of
the ongoing genocide in Gaza, AIPAC is getting sneakier with its
involvement in Democratic primaries this time around.

The American Prospect recently outlined “The Pro-Israel Super PAC
Cinematic Universe” that’s intervening in this year’s races.

Instead of just openly spending through their super PAC, AIPAC and
Democratic Majority for Israel (DMFI) have funneled millions of dollars
into nine vaguely named shell PACs such as Pro-Choice Majority Action and
Elect Democratic Women Action Fund, to covertly support candidates who
will be a rubber-stamp for their pro-genocide agenda in Congress.

The tide is turning against AIPAC and the rest of the pro-Israel lobby,
and they know it. That’s why they’re trying to deceive voters while
spending big to hold onto these House seats.

In the past few weeks, we beat them in Denver and New York, and we have
two more massive fights with them on August 4th: the rematch between Cori
Bush and Rep. Wesley Bell in MO-01, and Donavan McKinney’s challenge to
Rep. Shri Thanedar in MI-13.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260711-2.0GMw-2&refcode=em20260711-38016&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=38016%2E1203867%2EMesUOI ]We’ve defeated AIPAC with people power before — help us do it again and
again this August by fueling our work with a contribution of
$5 or more today.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260711-2.0GMw-2&refcode=em20260711-38016&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=38016%2E1203867%2EMesUOI ]Contribute $5

If we stop AIPAC from winning these next two primaries, it could set the
stage for the Democratic Party to reject the right-wing megadonor-funded
group once and for all.

— Justice Democrats

Hey, it's Mandela Barnes. I can't believe I am saying this, but we're one month out from our primary.
Election Day is almost here, and I'll be honest -- when I think about how far we've come and how much is riding on the next few weeks, I feel the weight of it. But I also feel ready.
### **What we 're up against**
Tom Tiffany is Donald Trump's hand-picked candidate for Governor of Wisconsin. He's got MAGA billionaires backing him every step of the way, writing checks and waiting to see if they can buy this state. _That 's the reality we're operating in._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4ec0e1d1-5a7d-4f14-a706-0fcf3fdbf6ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

### **For the next 30 days ...**
From now until August 11th, every door knocked and voter contacted matters. The ground game we build in the next month is the one we take into the general, and we need it to be strong.

\- Mandela

| | Fellow Patriot,

If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

body:
Not what I spent my time doing

| | | | | |
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDcxMV9VSS1QTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NTUzMjQtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA3MTFfVUktUE4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTU1MzI0LTIwNjgifQ/K2mhaZl6Fs4N8_95yQDCLA)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don’t have a massive machine behind me. I don’t have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDcxMV9VSS1QTi4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NTUzMjQtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA3MTFfVUktUE4uMTEwMTE3X3QxOTU1MzI0LTIwNjgifQ/pIOlj84Yxj-HtYqohd2PwQ)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

name: Enoch for Congress
subject: Join Us for the John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Weekend of Action!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
On Saturday, July 18, we invite you to stand with us for our Weekend of Action: John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Canvass Launch as Democrats...

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
There are moments in history when showing up matters.
On **Saturday, July 18** , we invite you to stand with us for our **Weekend of Action:**
**John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Canvass Launch** as Democrats from across our community come together to organize, engage voters, and continue the work of building a stronger, more inclusive democracy.
**📅 Saturday, July 18**
**📍 Kemper Meadow Park**
1280 West Kemper Road
Cincinnati, OH 45240
This special event honors the legacy of Congressman **John Lewis** , who reminded us that democracy is not a state—it is an act. Together, we'll put that belief into action by reaching voters throughout Ohio's 8th Congressional District and neighboring communities.
You'll have the opportunity to meet and support four Democratic candidates who are committed to fighting for working families, protecting our freedoms, and creating opportunities for every Ohioan:
* **Dr. Vanessa Enoch** – Candidate for U.S. Congress, Ohio's 8th District
* **Karen Brownlee** – Candidate for Ohio House, District 28
* **Cara Jacob** – Candidate for Ohio Senate, District 7
* **Jonathan Bradner** – Candidate for Ohio House, District 29

Whether you're an experienced volunteer or joining your very first canvass, we'll provide everything you need before heading out into the community. Bring your energy, wear comfortable shoes, and invite your friends and family to be part of this important day. Wear your Enoch for Congress t-shirt! If you don’t have one, email us your shirt size, and we will reserve a shirt for you (supplies are limited).
Every conversation with a voter helps build the movement. Every volunteer strengthens our campaign. Every door knocked brings us one step closer to the change our communities deserve.

### Bring a Friend!
Know someone who wants to make a difference? We'd love to have them on the team.
New volunteers can register here:[**https://campaign.app/volunteer**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=1e524c1c5e&e=c6e7dff14c)
Registered volunteers can sign up for campaign events, receive advance notice of volunteer opportunities, and become part of our growing grassroots movement.Together, let's honor John Lewis by making a little **"Good Trouble"** —the kind that moves our country forward.
We hope to see you on **Saturday, July 18!**
With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
_Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer._

The people of Pennsylvania's 7th District deserve leaders who follow the law, take responsibility, and practice what they preach. Unfortunately, my opponent has failed to meet this bar since day one - overshadowed by controversy after controversy.[Bob Brooks stole $162,000 from members of his own family](https://us.list-manage.com/GhTpRC6Lsem?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27). He borrowed from them, signed a promissory note to repay, but repeatedly refused to do so and the debt still remains unpaid years later - even after the courts ordered him to pay. [He actually apologized for supporting law enforcement](https://us.list-manage.com/PpGqV1Fai32?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27) and [called volunteer firefighters "scabs" and "sh*tbags.”](https://us.list-manage.com/hQ7_DCwLVD0?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)[Now Bob Brooks faces a new scandal following an independent news report that his personal business violated Pennsylvania's workers' compensation law](https://us.list-manage.com/cMsg4Ov_e8D?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27) according to Free Beacon and Breitbart. This is especially disturbing because Mr. Brooks has constantly touted himself as a hero of working people - but did not carry required workers’ compensation insurance that would protect his employees in case of injury. And he did it for more than four years! That's not standing with workers — and it's a classic case of **"do as I say, not as I do”** hypocrisy.

The Postal Service announced that it will no longer deliver mail ballots for states that don't hand over voter lists.
Right now every blue state in the nation is declining to share their voter list with the White House because sharing them would give MAGA the names and addresses of every Democratic voter.
In the short term it helps MAGA rig elections by knowing exactly whose ballots to challenge and throw out. But the long term is far more disturbing. It will give the administration and aligned far-right paramilitary groups the ability to know where every Democrat lives.
No governor in their right mind would go along with handing over that data, so what this amounts to is simple: blue state voters no longer have the right to vote by mail.

### **America 250 kicked ass.**
We braved the traffic and weather to head into DC for the largest fireworks display ever, some 850,000 shells. In the hours preceding it, our military flyovers left people in awe. Every man and child froze, head turned up to the skies, like aliens had fixed a tractor beam on their skulls, watching the most extraordinary show of air power. Fighter jets. Stealth bombers. Apaches. The **[F-35 hovering](https://substack.com/redirect/bef598dc-8881-416b-a6cd-b256573f3a15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over the reflecting pool at the Jefferson Memorial, up, down, left right, like line dancing at a honkey tonk.
_**We need this every year.**_
The pilots require the training hours and the machines need to run anyway. That was my response to any beta naysayers who talked about "the expense" of this display. These jets don't sit under a tarp until Trump orders them to bomb **[muslim terrorists](https://substack.com/redirect/06d037fe-8414-4a16-8c9e-2f0dbcd53a6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in Nigeria on Christmas Day (best Christmas ever).
Let July 4th be a massive training exercise and let the American people enjoy it, too.
It fosters patriotism. It inspires young people. Of the millions of people who watched flyovers in DC or New York or up and down the coasts, somewhere, a little kid saw it, and a fire was ignited inside. And a serviceman was born.
That got me thinking: let us foster patriotism by performing overtly patriotic acts.
Your tomatoes start to come in? I bet they have, but let's go back a few months to late February when you first tended the beds, started to aerate and fertilize. And then you planted, watered, weeded, pruned, staked... now you give them as gifts and people say "wow, great tomatoes". Substitute any virtue and it's the same effort: overt, deliberate, laborious acts to cultivate a fruit.
Let us cultivate patriotism in our garden of virtues.
Fly the flag at your home, on your fence or gate. No flag? Flag stickers on your mailbox, your car, your laptop. It wards off evil like wearing a cross around your neck. Numerous celebrities and internet personalities share their disdain for flag. Sunny Hostin, one of the nitwit shrieking sows on The View, **[recently said](https://substack.com/redirect/0aabe421-3637-4774-beaf-d87db6826bba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** she feels "unsafe" when she sees the flag. Let me hang up two more then, because I feel "unsafe" when commies like Sunny come into my neighborhood.
Here's my red, white, and blue crucifix, vampire. Back to hell with you.
I've listed some other acts of patriotism we can perform.

### **3\. Visit Patriotic Places**
This is geography dependent, I know, and growing up in New York City events like "The Battle of Long Island" were easier to visit when it was just crossing a bridge. I even remember as a kid learning about "The Battle of Brooklyn Heights" as the neighborhood where The Huxtables lived.
Take your family to Philadelphia and Boston. Every city has free tours and free guides and those reenactors dying for someone to interact with their wealth of knowledge.
Visit Revolutionary and Civil War battlefields and cemeteries. I walked through the almost 13,000 unmarked graves in Fredericksburg, one of which belongs to my great-great grandfather. I have been all over Gettysburg. Our nation does great work to preserve them.
**GO. TO. THE. PARADE**. The small-town Memorial Day parade (which that same aforementioned liberal demon spawn city councilor is desperate to cancel) is desperate for attendees.
**Show-up.** Take the kids. Take the grandkids. Rally the group. Boy, am I guilty of this one. I'm not far from town, but driving, parking... it's easier to say: "I can't make it". There is no doubt if grabbed a few friends and packed a cooler, I could get a decent crowd to cheer on the parade. We would have patriotic fun. You can drink in public if it's for America. It's why God invented the red solo cup.
OK, that is on my "to do" list for America. Look at that. Inspired myself.
### **4\. Read**
I have a bro's book club. We call it "bro's book club" because "book club" sounds... gay. It started very much on accident as one friend Justin and another friend Colin were both reading Ron Chernow's masterpiece "Grant", and I had just purchased it. "You should read it and then we can discuss it together" one said, and they sat in awkward silence unsure what this experimentation even meant. It wasn't June. I think Colin ordered a shot of whiskey... but we did it anyway, and since 2017 our group has read several similar books together, in a totally masculine way.
Read with your buddies. Read with your siblings. Read with your kids. Ebay is full of people selling great books for $5. Every roadside "antique" store has books from someone's grandpa's basement for $1. Buy them and read them. TV is garbage. The internet is poison (except for this Substack and other channels affiliated with **[The Capitalist](https://substack.com/redirect/bbd0b371-f986-4fdf-91e3-03c3a8ab2f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** including **[Politibrawl](https://substack.com/redirect/db6293a5-8d08-48b0-b8c3-d8f67ca9cddc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**).

Let the city comptroller protest when you demand to recite the Pledge. Let the kids roll their eyes when you tell to memorize the Bill of Rights. I’m grateful.
**Thousands of people have chipped in to my campaign for the first time this week.** These contributions are coming at a critical moment in this race, and it means a lot to me to have new folks join us.
We’re off to a good start in July – but if we want to hit our fundraising goals outta the park this month...
We simply cannot take our foot off the gas.
The GOP is pummeling me with attack ads, and now, a new poll shows me 3 points down to Republican Jon Husted. But that poll is within the margin of error – **so now a shady dark-money group just committed $28 million to take the lead once and for all and defeat me.**

I'm requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master's from Harvard, a Master's Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. My request of you will end in one of two ways: 1. . 2. You might have read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I'm not a career politician. I'm a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation's call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn't the Minnesota I grew up in - or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don't live in Minnesota, then I'm sure you'll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today - individuals of integrity. That's not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven't done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn't voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I've faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington. Here's what I stand for: Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left's agenda that's eroding the America we love. This race won't be easy. The Democrats have deep pockets, and the radical left will stop at nothing to keep this seat. I'm running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you'll invest in me right now - any amount will help. subject: Countdown to Election Day: One Month Left!
body:
One month from now is election day here in Wisconsin. I am so excited!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ffa491b56f09/c2y1sg9w12-10123187?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/SwmLQ8IMoRs?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,

One month from now is election day here in Wisconsin. I am so excited, and also kind of nervous.
We’ve built an amazing campaign together. I’ve gotten to meet so many fantastic Wisconsinites on the trail and had the chance to attend events that have taken me to every corner of the state. From walking in parades, to attending forums, to learning more about the people who make our state great - this has been an incredible experience. And in one month, I hope to be your democratic nominee for state treasurer.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1Cvj_T7t0Mr?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |

A big part of running is getting the word out, and in these last 30 days, I could really use your support. I’ll keep criss-crossing Wisconsin and meeting people where they’re at - but a donation today helps us expand who we can reach on such a short timeframe.
I have events planned from Superior to Kenosha, from Milwaukee to Green Bay, and of course, a ton here in my home county, Dane County. I’m really proud of the campaign we’ve built together and our chance to use public power for the public good. Please make a plan to vote either by mailing your absentee ballot soon, going to early vote in person (starting July 28th), or voting on election day.
[**And if you’re able, please consider making a contribution so we can pay for our final tour of the state, purchase all the literature we need, and reach voters who still haven’t made up their minds. Your $15, $25, $40 or more contribution really makes a difference in who we can reach.**](https://us.list-manage.com/vVenv4YY6qh?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
We’d love it if you follow along with the campaign on socials too - [Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/xCbvHn2GjHI?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09), [Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/4TqfZe6Th7W?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09), [TikTok](https://us.list-manage.com/EA5ahPq14Hr?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09).
Thank you,Dylan

body:

With the majority decided by a razor-thin margin, they are preparing a massive wave of outside spending to overwhelm us. This was the most expensive House race in 2024 – so I'm no stranger to outside attacks.
But the truth is that holding this line here is how we win a Democratic majority and block the extreme MAGA agenda hurting so many.

It’s difficult to admit that I can't do this alone. [**There's so much weighing on me right now, and finding the right words feels impossible. But I'm trusting these words will reach you the way they need to.**](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/WlWaFzk0VVFvUi85lV24wAnilD_NsiaY34KwTD3sOZ3Tzucj3vS8qPH2XVG7Ff0AinjyCltrMhLmMytNwou3KIEitQW3Zg-Z23fdQFdhnTVcGcG_npcgafBDnPMGOTgANSGGyP0babq5C83JLp5o7Mawpz8mSmH1khORNeixXVMkHu7mCs8owSiu5jlq-Ke0rY5rxvVRDILL8mqsAfEgAXNiJmBEv5IRmhrkPkyiuZywXHMjzPMOmmIwDng-9ziYhFdJkQQKTMM5urEEGFCujGpWmdxal7ffSsgVBeGa1hT9emuUKHGLs49hwAoD0EqElEt1STXrJ9KhKzJ18htzn85cugVryWnEJ43S6jP9lkRAjhrt9oU2-nK7tyuxJ4Zsp-UNJXRxiNTkt--MSI6GlWuEz_KeDrERhW3V0olxHrBAGiue6ZME5gfBRP04RmExc_eKA1H2jddAyouaxRCIUpIYU7ewibsxrIFh7d9yijh2taXs7Azn10VDF88HEYt5wodewdFlFFKyjXiW9zCuGgviX4anRe1WrFT3oJ_tHmyEeDIbOGMo0Tc5NO9spUxIgF36ixZmg3l2KIF_Ud6gEdt7sN4JhSIjmet_s7z2YXvA5jVCTQd9QQPJKQb9f5Rc3a6zvlGwm_Ia1mbpneoHIrUOszeoQ-fbeZUSMQDFBYYXZwNRj1lmwLQnSuKrMiYMUV5KTvl7HzPaQVG_LzIyyU5jOtKdyXMLrEm5KXn20cLMn8AWu6KVEftsJI9T4SSv-8-NcYz3_W4-T_QoQBH6nBmslOJePAb2yyU7B5FDqarhH5WGLby5Pqbk4Gfiu4zIhTfF9QM/2tzAiL7bINT6E9VoQM7wzf0U3biH8C9j/22) It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. I didn't come to Washington because I love asking true patriots like you for money. I didn't run for Congress at 29 years old to become the youngest House Republican so I could spend my nights begging for donations. I came because my kids deserve to grow up in a better America than I grew up in — and right now, that's not guaranteed. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father Almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. I refuse to look my kids in the eye someday and tell them I gave up when it mattered most. [**That's why I'm still here. That's why I keep sending these messages.**](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/ZW1kd8BBKsTAxxj0npYfWthBz58tkQjxrmP5fP_cafpSiiYMZUG4Dlh9xv5TLiJJFxcjwqkBkl9sUXyMjetfkD_hLr2ywqJwY2bFb-P4-B4SUG7Yiy-858X6ip-bwOuKQUQUnyO-hCq0dOfCVf-5DLZ6Ek1E4BAT8_1ggMHr_0U3FGQj9s8F8VVtKeee6gfEt4cZzdmZ5utg74ME5YZ12nEKSVBuFK-li3DMjMtP7-erBBGz0W-bYO2EYrVHUmAkixFWL2UPlAk0n3dZeM8l4aavR6j6S-NTZYepyiYRs8aFzmskKyzpt5lsLsEzM2RobMmYmBrBLeJhndqkwv95-BjIJTNuvq5h5U_j2vmDjG_-XeCWTlYGdLmW-Npa11sx1Tx80uHjubmE96PdnkHrB49l2K5Z6epmK4YifHELxUoRXuEaN4jIWnJUxwszVg_-H_fm4U4XUsfWwiDrVLewg57YQf6QsK1yeD8yfhzzhxZ50L8ppYN0k2OPggdvmFa5R0FYcheSRPd5qrnCO9ejlAnGjIx_asJTJZguPTCF5clZ3Vz9BeCuA09yO-7HbVGGMmiNKMCfD8Aro2VGwsuq2hzGYSBG496xntxI2PN1WeMo39pXx3adPCxvdTvDqWkToHAboX0kEXa5t_OhLtnchyLTs1AUDJoEmw3vt-COioKx-SjWhpj2Nf7kb3no02RaFU9YRZr43VtNib_N6VPbFd50yFMFANeqVEWxTzifytZ_AAsgkC45RASGcqgTKaN9fjp1TQcEWLIWDjYaSe842_rrDInkVa6wiCJE7HohjzbTv-7bAB465k4Cq3H7vOc1IIlrfeA/r1nWkdQKHSTCPy49W-iO33lwJ8kL-0wp/22) Because nothing — I repeat — nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country. The left hates you. They hate your vote. They hate MAGA for putting America First. And they will do anything — lie, cheat, steal, destroy — to ensure your children inherit a country you won't even recognize. Peter, today I'll make the same promise to you that I've made to myself, to my wife, and to my children: As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Not the attacks. Not the exhaustion. Not the constant pressure to give up and go home. clean_body: | | | | Peter, I went back and forth on if I should send you this or not. Not because I didn't know what to say, but because I knew how much it would hurt to say it. It’s difficult to admit that I can't do this alone. It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. name: Enoch for Congress
subject: Join Us for the John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Weekend of Action!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
On Saturday, July 18, we invite you to stand with us for our Weekend of Action: John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Canvass Launch as Democrats...

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
There are moments in history when showing up matters.
On **Saturday, July 18** , we invite you to stand with us for our **Weekend of Action:**
**John Lewis Good Trouble Rally & Canvass Launch** as Democrats from across our community come together to organize, engage voters, and continue the work of building a stronger, more inclusive democracy.
**📅 Saturday, July 18**
**📍 Kemper Meadow Park**
1280 West Kemper Road
Cincinnati, OH 45240
This special event honors the legacy of Congressman **John Lewis** , who reminded us that democracy is not a state—it is an act. Together, we'll put that belief into action by reaching voters throughout Ohio's 8th Congressional District and neighboring communities.
You'll have the opportunity to meet and support four Democratic candidates who are committed to fighting for working families, protecting our freedoms, and creating opportunities for every Ohioan:
* **Dr. Vanessa Enoch** – Candidate for U.S. Congress, Ohio's 8th District
* **Karen Brownlee** – Candidate for Ohio House, District 28
* **Cara Jacob** – Candidate for Ohio Senate, District 7
* **Jonathan Bradner** – Candidate for Ohio House, District 29

Whether you're an experienced volunteer or joining your very first canvass, we'll provide everything you need before heading out into the community. Bring your energy, wear comfortable shoes, and invite your friends and family to be part of this important day. Wear your Enoch for Congress t-shirt! If you don’t have one, email us your shirt size, and we will reserve a shirt for you (supplies are limited).
Every conversation with a voter helps build the movement. Every volunteer strengthens our campaign. Every door knocked brings us one step closer to the change our communities deserve.

### Bring a Friend!
Know someone who wants to make a difference? We'd love to have them on the team.
New volunteers can register here:[**https://campaignhq.app/volunteer**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=9d7ab9d323&e=c6e7dff14c)
Registered volunteers can sign up for campaign events, receive advance notice of volunteer opportunities, and become part of our growing grassroots movement.Together, let's honor John Lewis by making a little **"Good Trouble"** —the kind that moves our country forward.
We hope to see you on **Saturday, July 18!**
With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
_Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer._

Congress will be decided six weeks before Election Day.
That's not a prediction. That's a fact.
By the time November arrives, millions of ballots will already be cast — early votes banked during the weeks before Election Day by whichever side worked harder to collect them.
**In 2024, Turning Point PAC worked harder.**
We funded thousands of full-time ballot-chasers into America's swing states. Their mission: Find conservative voters who support the GOP but never quite make it to the polls. Men and women whose ballots sit on kitchen counters — unopened, unreturned, wasted.
Our ballot-chasers knocked their doors, made a plan with them, and put their ballots in the box. All 5 swing states went red. Republicans won _big_.
**We're doing it again in 2026 — and we need your help to fund it.**

Each ballot-chaser will:
➡️ Engage low-propensity conservative voters ***starting now*** ➡️ Help them make a plan to vote early ➡️ **Bank 10 ballots per day** during the early voting window
The math?
**1,000 chasers × 10 ballots/day = 10,000 votes locked in EVERY DAY Over 20 days = 200,000+ conservative votes BANKED**
Why do those numbers matter? Because House races flip on **fewer than 5,000 votes.** Senate races are commonly **decided by less than 1%.**
**Ballot-chasing is the margin. It decides who controls Congress.**

Every dollar you contribute goes directly into the field:
🟢 **$50** → Supports ONE chaser → hundreds of early votes banked 🟢 **$100** → Supports TWO chasers → double the votes banked 🟢 **$250** → Powers a targeted turnout team in a swing district 🟢 **$500** → Funds a full precinct push in a toss-up race 🟢 **$1,000+** → Surges operations in a must-win district
The early voting window won't wait.

Hi Peter,
it’s Andy Levin, former Congressman for Michigan’s 9th district.

dollars (that came mostly from Republican billionaires) to defeat me in a
Democratic primary! They were threatened by our people-powered campaign
that challenged corporate and dark money influence in our politics.

Unfortunately, we came up short, but the movement we built didn’t
disappear.

I’ve continued organizing — because the fight to build a government that
prioritizes people over profit is the cause of our lives.

Now, those same forces are targeting Michigan’s Senate race. AIPAC will
spend whatever it takes to stop a truth-telling candidate like Abdul.

competitive primary by chipping in $10 today?

Peter, if we
want our next senator to be someone who fights for working people, for
healthcare, for clean water, and for a democracy not controlled by
billionaire interests, Abdul is the best candidate for the job.

He’s the only candidate in this race who has never taken money from
corporate PACs or AIPAC, and never will. That means we can trust him to
fight for our best interests, but it also means he needs us to fuel this
campaign.

I know firsthand what it looks like when dark money groups try to buy an
election. Abdul is facing that on an even bigger scale.

But Abdul can win this race. He’s leading in the polls, he’s built a real
coalition, and he has the moral courage we desperately need in this
moment. This movement just has to show up for him.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260711-3-ak.BozOmR&amount=10&refcode=em20260711-2589&t=1008&akid=2589%2E251025%2E5a5xK9 ]So I’m asking — organizer to organizer, neighbor to neighbor — will you

Hey y’all,

I’m Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician, a mom of three, and the Democrat running for U.S. Senate to defeat Republican Lindsey Graham in South Carolina.
If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections.
I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional.
We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
Let me introduce myself.
I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty.
I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children.
In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again.
But then Trump’s chaos came back.
And Lindsey Graham? He cheered.
The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting.
So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham.
I’m building a people-powered campaign to flip South Carolina and give kids the voice they deserve. And I need your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]

One month to the primary
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260711-3021)
Peter,
One month to go y’all, one month to Make Better Possible and fight for Wisconsin that cares about working people.
One month left and we thought it was a good time to look at where we’ve been—but one month left also means one more fundraising deadline. We have a goal of raising $250,000 before the end of the election on August 11th and _every single donation helps_. Contribute what you can today.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260711.0ADFdk&amount=5&refcode=em20260711-3021&t=3&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)**
**[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260711.0ADFdk&refcode=em20260711-3021&t=4&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)**_We’ve come so far!_[_We even have cool t-shirts!_](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16545?t=5&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)
This campaign started from a desire to push for better than we’ve been given. We need a politics where people actually hear from their elected officials, and *gasp* can even ask them questions face-to-face. I’ve traveled across Wisconsin to meet as many people as possible from school houses to concert halls.
**[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260711.0ADFdk&refcode=em20260711-3021&t=6&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)**
_[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260711.0ADFdk&refcode=em20260711-3021&t=7&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)The crowds have been getting larger..._
What keeps me so excited both for this campaign and for the future, is the kindness of our supporters and the way our vision of care has attracted thousands of people to take action for folks that they’ll never meet. None of this works without a devotion to service that only comes from people who love Wisconsin and love their communities. I appreciate, **_so much,_** what you have all done and what we are going to do next.
It won’t be easy, and I’m going to ask you for money a few more times in the next 30 days, but I’m so excited to be a Governor who comes out of the dish-pit rather than the C-suite.
**[If you’re able, please throw us $15, $25, $50 (or more!) to help us close strong.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260711.0ADFdk&refcode=em20260711-3021&t=8&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)**

**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260711.0ADFdk&amount=5&refcode=em20260711-3021&t=12&akid=3021%2E105371%2EGrQvJF)**
With gratitude,
Fran

| | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

Here's the what we know:
The group is called One Nation, and they're affiliated with GOP Senate leadership. The thing is, they raise and spend unlimited, often anonymous funds. That means any number of wealthy individual donors, special interest groups, or large corporations could be buying political power by trying to flood this race with outside cash.
**This is exactly the rigged system that Sherrod is working to dismantle.** He and I have discussed running his campaign the right way – _where we count on hundreds of thousands of regular people chipping in_ – and not like our opponent, who relies on an Epstein co-conspirator, dark money super PACs, and special interest groups cutting massive checks.
Sherrod is bearing the brunt of Republican spending because Ohio is the domino that will give Democrats the Senate.

body:

[](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2607-email?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&amount=5&source=email_su_pros_jtk773&t=8&akid=2055%2E124072%2EYV7G2x)
Peter,

I’m Roy Cooper, and I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. Today, I wanted to reach out to you specifically not to ask for a contribution – but instead, to share a bit more about myself and ask for your personal endorsement in this race.
[**_If you’re already all in to flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate, please add your name now to help us build the grassroots movement we need to win._**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2607-email?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&amount=5&source=email_su_pros_jtk773&t=9&akid=2055%2E124072%2EYV7G2x)
Otherwise, let me explain why your support, and your signature today, is so important.

I’ve spent my life serving the people of North Carolina.
As Governor, I expanded Medicaid to hundreds of thousands of hardworking people and fought for better health care. As Attorney General, I protected working families from fraud and abuse. As a State Legislator, I pushed for policies that made everyday people’s lives easier.
**But before all of this, I was just a boy from Nash County – the son of a public school teacher who tried to do right by his family, friends and neighbors.**
Now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I’ve seen what’s possible when government actually puts people first. When those in power lead with a sense of duty, purpose and moral clarity. That’s not happening in Washington DC right now, and we have to change that.
[**_The path to retaking the Senate majority for Democrats runs straight through North Carolina – but in a race that is going to come down to a handful of votes, we can't win without a powerful grassroots team behind me. So please, will you add your name to personally endorse my campaign?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2607-email?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&amount=5&source=email_su_pros_jtk773&t=10&akid=2055%2E124072%2EYV7G2x)

---
Every signature is an act of faith in the movement we’re building together. Thank you.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8188?t=2&akid=2055%2E124072%2EYV7G2x)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.
